test_item:
The software shall provide cryptographic operations using temporary keys for the LogDog client when operational keys are not installed.
(keys are not installed; a temporary key is provided)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A USB drive containing valid platform keys is inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
2. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall status test runner
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 0
2. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall status test runner
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
